The input-pair cascodes push gain to about gm1/gds4, about 40 dB, which lets the PMOS mirror use short L (0.5) and keeps the mirror pole above 400 MHz. A resistor-lifted bias sets the cascode gate. Expected output swing is about 0.75 to 1.6 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # input pair L (speed)
    "Id1":   (105e-6, 70e-6, 180e-6),# per-side current
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmidc": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS cascode gm/Id
    "Lc":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),       # NMOS cascode L
    "gmidt": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # tail / reference mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # tail L
    "vmarg": (0.22, 0.12, 0.40),     # Vds headroom given to the input pair beyond its source
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    Id1 = p["Id1"]
    Itail = 2 * Id1

    # tail and reference mirror (same L and gm/Id; currents scale 1:Itail/iref)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=0.25)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # input pair: estimate the tail node, then resize with body effect
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=p["vmarg"], vsb=0.2)
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=p["vmarg"], vsb=max(vs, 0.0))
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    vd1 = vs + p["vmarg"]                       # input-pair drain voltage

    # PMOS mirror load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Id1, vds=0.6)
    vd_diode = vdd - mp.vgs

    # NMOS cascodes: the source sits at vd1
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], Id1,
                  vds=max(vd_diode - vd1, 0.2), vsb=vd1)
    vcas = vd1 + mc.vgs

    # cascode gate bias = Vgs(mb) + iref*R (resistor-lifted diode)
    R = max((vcas - mb.vgs) / iref, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF -> R -> diode mb; ibias node = vcas
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nb", R)
    n.dev("Mb", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("Mt", "s", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # input pair (vinp on the diode side gives non-inverting behaviour at vout)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinp", "s", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinn", "s", "vss", m1)
    # cascodes
    n.dev("Mc1", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("Mc2", "vout", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rcas = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / mc.gds / m1.gds   # cascoded NMOS side output resistance
    gout = mp.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = mp.cdd + mc.cdd + mc.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))
    cmir = 2 * mp.cgg + mc.cdd + mp.cdd
    fp_m = mp.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    fp_c = mc.gm / (2 * PI * (mc.cgg + m1.cdd + 1e-15))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp_m)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp_m))) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp_c))
    slew = Itail / (cl + cpar)
    vlow = vd1 + mc.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vhigh - vlow
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "psrr_db": db(A0) - 3, "swing": swing,
               "power": vdd * (Itail + iref)}
